profile.headline: UAV Software Engineer at Aurora Flight Sciences Corporation
profile.summary:
Detail oriented and motivated Mechanical Engineering with background in system integration,  software validation, and closed loop PID feedback controls.

Proficient in MATLAB / Simulink , Canape and working knowledge in C/C++ and Tableau

positions.title: UAV Software Engineer
positions.description:
Define, analyze and review system and software requirements to meet program needs using IBM DOORS Requirements Management and Confluence software
Design and implement functional model-based code approach using Simulink/Stateflow and C/C++
Write test plans and test cases to conduct unit, integration and system level testing

positions.title: Mechatronics Engineer
positions.description:
Own multiple projects focusing on new product introduction(NPI) and continuous process improvement (CPI) for engines and machines
Next generation focus team member, providing and generating technical feedback on control strategies requirements, design, implementation and documentation

positions.title: Senior Associate Engineer
positions.description:
Engineering Rotational Development Program
Assisted on development, debugging and testing of new autonomous features on machine at proving grounds to achieve ideal design of strategy

Created FMEAs of features and utilized Tableau dashboards to analyze field data to improve new controls strategies
Developed linear model-based software using Simulink according to functional requirements
Analytically resolved CAN and J1939 ECU communication issues on production line machines via phone or in-person visits
Developed and ran test procedures to create emission compliant calibration on engines
Performed hardware calibration and validation on exhaust gas recirculation valve on NPI project by conducting sine sweeps and creating bode plots
Designed and ran test procedures to create emission compliant calibration on engines 
Coordinated and debugged engine installs in test cells to perform rating development
Developed technical results documentation from data collected on engine development

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Mechanical Engineering Senior Design Project
Oversaw several projects to ensure projects are completed on time, on or under budget and with high quality results
Led 40 to 50 senior students each semester through high level design and prototyping to solving corporate sponsored projects
Helped with ongoing development and unification of the design process across all design classes in the department

positions.title: Mechatronics Intern
positions.description:
Performed hardware calibration and validation on ERV valve for new product introduction program (NPI)
Validated software strategies on engine ECM for cold weather performance in cold lab
Created post processing software for cylinder cut out test to determine injector health in field for large mining trucks

positions.title: Technology EID Co-Op
positions.description:
Owned multiple projects focused on improving quality, production yield and product cost reduction
New French door lighting technique to improve quality and reduce cost by $400K (docket filed)
Preformed root cause analysis and implemented a solution to door alignments 
Assisted in designing of new dispenser display for K-Cup series fridges on N.P.I. team

positions.title: Research Aid
positions.description:
Research based on Niobium doped Strontium Titanate (STO-Nb).

Operated Pulsed Laser Deposition system for ablating STO-Nb on silicon substrate
Annealed ablated substrate to control crystal structure of STO-Nb
Worked in a team of 3 to design and assemble a Mid-Grade Vacuum system
Ran and measured current – voltage for characterizing material
Presented weekly findings to professors for further examination

positions.title: Teacher's Assistant
positions.description:
Graded papers and provided feedback for over 100 students weekly
Assisted and tutored students with coursework by holding 20 office hours weekly
Designed and coordinated class with professor
Implemented and conducted AutoCAD and Autodesk Inventor software tutorials and assignments
Assigned group projects to build machines that play mini-golf, corn hole(bags), and bowling

positions.title: Computer Consultant and Micro Repairs
positions.description:
Provided customer support with computers, programs, and university’s websites
Answered any computing, communications, and technological questions
Trouble shot lab computers, printers, and security devices
Diagnosed,repaired and maintained faculty and student computers
Installed system software updates, and virus removals

volunteerExperiences.description: Helping build houses in the community.

projects.title: Mechanical Dart Launcher
projects.description: This was a project for ME 371, a mechanical design course. Our team created an extremely unique dart thrower that launched a dart backwards towards the dart board. The dart would then flip around in the air and stick into the board. This design earned us an honorable mention in the semester’s dart throwing competition. We were able to exhibit our design at the 2014 Engineering Open House as well.
